fusions.name: Seam Finder
fusions.desc: Claws an enemy through a gap in its guard for 4 damage and strips 5% of its armour for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Steel-Shod Landing
fusions.desc: Slams down with your full weight, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. The blow ignores armour.

fusions.name: Supple Plate
fusions.desc: Increases your armour by 20% for 10 seconds. You also gain 6% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Scale on Scale
fusions.desc: Every blow you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (46% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
